prior_findings.title: Mandatory scripts-integration check fails due to new -buildvcs=true build argument
prior_findings.scenario: Running the scripts integration suite on the test-merge commit executes scripts/start-wukongim-three-nodes.sh with fake go binaries. The fakes in scripts/wukongim_three_nodes_script_integration_test.go match build invocations via "$2" == "-o"; with the PR's new argument order 'build -buildvcs=true -o ...', $2 is '-buildvcs=true', so the fake exits 2 with 'unexpected go build args'.
prior_findings.impact: TestWukongIMThreeNodeScriptReportsNodeExitWithEmptyAllowList and TestWukongIMThreeNodeScriptBuildsStartsAndStopsNodes fail, and the mandatory scripts-integration check reports failed (exit 1) on the test-merge commit bcda7a8. The mandatory-check gate cannot pass with this change as written.
evidence: check:scripts-integration outcome=failed: 'unexpected go build args: build -buildvcs=true -o ... ./cmd/wukongim' in TestWukongIMThreeNodeScriptBuildsStartsAndStopsNodes and TestWukongIMThreeNodeScriptReportsNodeExitWithEmptyAllowList
scripts/start-wukongim-three-nodes.sh:196,198 add '-buildvcs=true' to both BUILD_COMMAND variants (patch before/after reconstruction confirms this is the only shell change)
scripts/wukongim_three_nodes_script_integration_test.go:204,283 fake go binaries require "$2" == "-o" and are untouched by this PR
prior_findings.resolution: Reconcile the buildvcs change with the integration harness: update the fake go scripts in scripts/wukongim_three_nodes_script_integration_test.go to accept '-buildvcs=true' as $2, and get the mandatory scripts-integration check to pass on the test-merge commit; alternatively revert the -buildvcs=true addition (and the two expectation updates) to keep this PR deletion-only.

prior_findings.title: Undisclosed -buildvcs=true behavior change in a PR scoped as deletion-only cleanup
prior_findings.scenario: The PR title/body and intent digest describe only removal of the retired LocalOwnerPusher and the local-medium-rc harness plus the FLOW.md update. The candidate additionally changes the local three-node build command to force VCS stamping, altering binary build metadata behavior for all users of the script.
prior_findings.impact: The change silently expands the PR's blast radius beyond its reviewed intent: the build command now depends on VCS stamping succeeding (and silently produces unstamped binaries in environments where Go refuses VCS metadata, as the failing TestWukongIMThreeNodeLocalE2EBuildUsesSelectedWorktreeRevision shows in this harness), and the behavior change was never disclosed or independently validated.
evidence: PR body lists only three deletion/doc changes; the diff additionally adds '-buildvcs=true' at scripts/start-wukongim-three-nodes.sh:196,198
scripts/wukongim_three_nodes_script_test.go expectations were updated to the new build command, showing the change is deliberate but undisclosed
check:scripts-integration shows TestWukongIMThreeNodeLocalE2EBuildUsesSelectedWorktreeRevision still fails because the Go toolchain omits vcs.revision in this environment even with -buildvcs=true
prior_findings.resolution: Either move the -buildvcs=true change into its own PR with an updated intent description and a passing scripts-integration check, or explicitly disclose it in this PR's summary and reconcile the harness so the mandatory check passes.
